Spoiler-free mood: When celebrated harbor engineer Alaric Venn vanishes during the unveiling of Tideglass Quay, the city’s new floodgate project is thrown into scandal. Moments before his disappearance, the old chapel bell rings through fog from a locked, condemned tower. SirLocked and his companion must separate civic pageantry from hidden grudges, test witness accounts against physical evidence, and uncover whether Venn was taken, fled, or met with something more sinister.
